content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the TMB Branch Head (Assistant Vice President / Senior Manager / Manager Rank) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 12-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of TMB to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: TMB Branch Head Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment process for the Branch Head posts is conducted by Tamilnad Mercantile Bank (TMB), a leading private sector bank in India, offering exciting career opportunities for experienced banking professionals.

faq.question: Q2. What positions are available under this recruitment notification?
faq.answer: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank is recruiting candidates for the post of Branch Head across different career ranks, including Manager, Senior Manager, and Assistant Vice President (AVP).

faq.question: Q3. What are the important dates to apply online?
faq.answer: The online registration process commences on 28 September 2026, and the final date to submit the completed online application form through the TMB career portal is 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess any Graduation or Post Graduation degree from a recognized university under the regular curriculum along with the requisite banking experience specified for each cadre.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for TMB Branch Head recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 30 and 45 years of age as on 31 August 2026. However, age relaxation may be considered for exceptionally deserving candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: No application fee is required to be paid by candidates applying for the TMB Branch Head (Manager, Senior Manager, AVP) recruitment across all candidate categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for TMB Branch Head posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises initial shortlisting of candidate applications followed by a personal interview round conducted by the bank authorities for qualified applicants.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the TMB Branch Head recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official TMB careers portal, registering with valid credentials, filling out the application form, and uploading necessary documents before the deadline.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I access the official recruitment notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF detailing the terms, conditions, vacancy distribution, and instructions can be downloaded directly from the Important Links section provided within this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Tamilnad Mercantile Bank for careers?
faq.answer: Candidates can access the dedicated online portal for job applications and career updates at https://apps.tmbdigital.bank.in/tmb_careers/
